subject: Rshiny gives error after loading rpart.object type using .RData file.

messages.author: c74268e622d66c32
messages.subject: Rshiny gives error after loading rpart.object type using .RData file.
parts:
I have saved the .Rdata file, which contains 3 R objects:

    1. Vector
    2. Character String
    3. rpart.object (I figured out that this object in .RData only creating issue, as if I remove this object from .RData file, Shiny app works fine.)

Whenever I load the .RData file, Rshiny gives error below:

Error in .rs.getShinyFunction(params$name, params$where) : 
  attempt to apply non-function

In order to avoid above issue, I tries following options:

1. Load the .RData in Global environment.
        
            load(infile$datapath,.GlobalEnv)

2. Load the .RData in New Environment.

        LoadToEnvironment <- function(RData, env = new.env())       { load(RData, env)  
         return(env) }  
       e <- LoadToEnvironment("D:\\Demo NBA\\AddOnPropensity.R")  
      val_modtyp <- e$val_modtyp  
      val_model <- e$val_model  
      val_b <-  e$val_b 

3. Load data Using attach(<filename>)

messages.subject: Re: Rshiny gives error after loading rpart.object type using .RData file.
parts:
RStudio Version 0.98.1062.
Shiny Version - 0.12.1
R Version - 3.1.3

Also, I got the same issue reproduced using RStudio Version  0.99.179 on my colleague's machine.

I have put the .Rdata file,which i used to upload for this code in above post.

Steps to reproduce the issue:

  1. Please run below simple code.
  2. Upload .Rdata file from above post.
  3. Refresh the application.
  4. It will give error below:

Error in .rs.getShinyFunction(params$name, params$where) : 
attempt to apply non-function

Simple Code:

===========


require(shiny)||install.packages("shiny"); library(shiny)


ui <- fluidPage(fileInput('filepm', 'Choose Data to Upload',accept = c(".R")))


server <- function(session,input,output){

LoadToEnvironment <<- function(RData, env = new.env())
{ load(RData, env)
return(env) }

val_choices <- reactive({
if (is.null(input$filepm)){
return() }
infile <- input$filepm

e <- LoadToEnvironment(infile$datapath)
e$val_b
})

observeEvent(input$filepm,{ 
if (is.null(input$filepm)){
return()}

val_choices()
})
}

shinyApp(ui,server)
